question: Can economically distinct trend direction, strength, quality, age, alignment, and transition representations be constructed stably across six broad-market indices in absolute, causal PIT-normalized, and contemporaneous relative coordinates?
research_role: strategy-independent Market State Engine construction and falsification

outcome_policy.selection_rule: construction coverage, same-role neighboring-horizon stability, nondegeneracy, and cross-role redundancy only

input.history_before_start: permitted only for causal rolling construction
input.post_2023: excluded before feature construction and absent from all outputs

pit_semantics.available_at: completed official close at 15:00 Asia/Shanghai under QD-003 available_at_from_completed_bar semantics
pit_semantics.first_actionable_time: next valid trading session; this experiment creates no action

quality.primary: abs(60-session log return) / sum(abs(daily log return), 60)

age.primary: consecutive completed sessions on the same side of MA60

alignment.primary: mean sign of MA20-MA60, MA20-MA120, and MA60-MA120

transition.primary: 20-session log return minus one third of 60-session log return
neighbors: 10-session log return minus one sixth of 60-session log return
30-session log return minus one half of 60-session log return

coordinates.pit_expanding_percentile: within-index causal percentile including the completed current observation; minimum 504 observations
coordinates.pit_3y_percentile: within-index trailing 756-session causal percentile including current; minimum 504 observations
coordinates.pit_3y_robust_z: within-index trailing 756-session median/MAD z; minimum 504 observations; zero MAD is missing
coordinates.relative: same-date cross-index percentile of the absolute primary when at least four indices are available

construction_gates.same_role_neighbor_stability: minimum median within-index Spearman rho across the two neighbors >= 0.70
construction_gates.index_year_nondegeneracy: all index-year cells with at least 150 observations have finite nonzero standard deviation
construction_gates.coordinate_coverage: all expected causal-PIT observations are populated unless MAD is exactly zero; relative coordinate requires >=4 indices
construction_gates.cross_role_redundancy: a passing role enters the minimal panel only when absolute pooled Spearman rho with every earlier accepted role is <= 0.85
construction_gates.no_rescue: a failed primary role is not replaced by the better-looking neighbor inside this experiment
